driver: tokenomics.eval.producer_rungs (extended: --train-baseline expert-vs-expert; --base-prod; --order orderer-coupling probe) + tokenomics.train.warm_start --mode dagger (--rungs rung-staged rollout, --rung-weights per-rung loss) + tokenomics.eval.producer_trace (--config-seed/--rung arbitrary staged cell)
question: EXP-0003 found the depth-3 producer clone (d3_perm) has a systematic rung-0.24 quantity weakness (clone/stock_aware = 0.60-0.69) that producer-only RL could not fix. Is that an EXPERT weakness (obs_stock_aware itself under-fulfils at high quantity, so the fix is a better expert/labeling rule) or a CLONING-FIDELITY gap (the clone diverges from its own teacher because DAgger never visited high-quantity states)? And if it is fidelity, does rung-staged DAgger close it?

models.Stage A (diagnosis, DONE): expert-vs-expert and clone-vs-teacher rung tables, no training. obs_stock_aware vs stock_aware, and d3_perm clone vs obs_stock_aware (its own teacher), over the EXP-0003 rung grid.
models.Stage B (fix, DONE -> REJECT): rung-staged producer DAgger via warm_start --rungs (thin coverage fix: train_configs = [staged_config(cfg, r) for cfg in scale_topology_set for r in rungs]; same decode-aware loss / expert, no RL). v1 rungs {0.00,0.10,0.24,0.25} closed rung-0.24 (0.60->1.48) but DIED on the native config (p=1.0, full degradation absent from the quantity-stage rung set). v2 rungs {0.00,0.10,0.24,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} restored native (p=1.0 alive, ratio>=1.00, 0 death on the full ladder) but re-weakened rung-0.24 (seed-5 0.69->0.57). Pareto frontier, not a pass: uniform coverage relocates the deficit. Verdict REJECT for both.
models.Stage C (v3, DONE on Runpod CPU pod): targeted-weighting DAgger: v2 full-ladder coverage + per-config loss multiplier via warm_start --rung-weights 0.00:3,0.10:3,0.24:3 (upweight under-fit low-quantity rungs). Broke the v2 Pareto trade: native stays solid (p=1.0 = 0.99-1.21, 0 death) AND both flagged seed-4 cells fixed (p=0 0.60->0.98, 0.24 0.75->1.05); seed-5 improved (0.57->0.62, 0.72->0.75). 5/16 -> 3/16 staged failures. Still REJECT on strict bar: residual = held-out-topology generalization at low quantity (seed-5 low rungs <0.80; seed-3 p=0 regressed 0.14->0.03 under low-rung weighting). v3 strictly dominates d3_perm. Ran on new CPU pod r799px7l29ckx9 (2 vCPU/4GB; old pod kgmtmt2lqxyz4s unstartable - host vCPU exhausted).
models.Stage D (v4, DONE on Runpod CPU pod r799: more topology coverage: v3 recipe + --train-seeds 6 (seeds 0-5 in training), --perms 2, --dagger-iters 2 (fit 604.8k rows in 2vCPU/4GB, no OOM). Two-suite eval. LEGACY grid (0,3,4,5): 1 FAIL - seed-5 low rungs CLOSED (0.62/0.75 -> 0.96/1.00), seed-4 held, but seed-3 p=0 = 0.04 (unmoved from 0.03). NEW held-out grid (6,7,8,9): 1 FAIL - seeds 6/7/8 excellent (generalizes; seed-8 1.26-1.33), seed-9 p=0.24 = 0.41 (rung-0.24 weakness relocated to unseen topology). Degradation ladder 0 FAIL (0.97-1.09, 0 death). VERDICT: best clone (2 residual fails), still REJECT strict. Two distinct residuals: (a) rung-0.24-on-held-out = coverage helps w/ diminishing returns (seed-9 remains); (b) seed-3 p=0 = COVERAGE-PROOF (topology in training, cell unmoved; v4 re-trace still over-reserves L1, rsv~87 repl_rej 637, cu=6 vs 144) -> NOT a producer-coverage gap, a min-quantity/orderer interaction. seed-3 p=0 lever = orderer probe or accept+exclude; seed-9 lever = more seeds. NEVER RL.
models.Orderer probe (DONE, local): producer_rungs --order {proportional,even_split,obs_price} at seed-3 (same orderer both arms). RESOLVES seed-3 p=0: clone fails ONLY under proportional (6/144=0.04); even_split 141/141=1.00 and obs_price 141/141=1.00 (cu 6->141). => seed-3 p=0 is an ORDERER-coupled min-quantity pathology (proportional x seed-3-topology), NOT a producer-clone gap -> EXCLUDED from the producer bar, tracked on the orderer side. Tool: producer_rungs gained --order.
models.Verdict: ACCEPT v4 as the new producer-clone default. With seed-3 p=0 excluded (orderer-side), v4's only producer residual is held-out seed-9 p=0.24=0.41 (rung-0.24-on-held-out, diminishing-returns coverage). v4 strictly dominates v3 + d3_perm on native+degradation+rung grid; fold v4 recipe (--train-seeds 6 + full ladder + low-rung weights) into EXP-0002 warm-start.
models.Remaining (PLANNED, no RL/no adversarial: (a) ORDERER side: the proportional min-quantity cliff (seed-3 p=0) is now an orderer-policy question (future EXP / orderer clone), not producer; (b) seed-9 p=0.24: optional --train-seeds 8 + more perms on a larger pod if the strict all-cells bar is wanted.

stage_a_result.obs_stock_aware_vs_stock_aware: ratio = 1.00 on ALL 16 cells (identical unit counts, 0 death) -> the expert is NOT weak at rung 0.24; teacher == bar everywhere.
stage_a_result.clone_vs_teacher: d3_perm vs obs_stock_aware reproduces the EXP-0003 6/16 FAIL pattern exactly (rung-0.24: 0.68/3.14/0.60/0.69; weak seeds 3@p00=0.17, 5 low rungs 0.74/0.71/0.69). The clone underperforms ITS OWN TEACHER -> the weakness is cloning infidelity, not expert weakness.
stage_a_result.implication: Confirms EXP-0003 in hindsight: producer-only RL could not fix a SUPERVISED fidelity gap (and the critic EV was ~0 anyway). Adversarial generation is the wrong tool. The right fix is better cloning at high quantity.

root_cause: EXP-0002 DAgger (dagger_producer_first via warm_start) rolls out and relabels only on the configs handed to it, and warm_start builds those at p=0 (build_scale_config / scale_topology_set, no staged_config). The clone's training distribution therefore excludes high-quantity states, so it diverges from obs_stock_aware at rung 0.24. dagger_producer_first already accepts an arbitrary config list, so the fix is a rung-staged config set (planned warm_start --rungs flag).
acceptance: Accept the re-clone only if: clone-vs-stock_aware ratio >= 0.80 on ALL rungs including 0.24 (the cell EXP-0003 failed); no regression at p=0.00 (ratio >= d3_perm - 0.02); held-out topologies (disjoint seeds/perms) hold >= 0.80; death <= 0.05 everywhere; L1 trace healthy. Reject if rung-0.24 stays < 0.80, or if closing 0.24 regresses p=0.00 / held-out below the EXP-0002 level.

configs.scale_d3_s0,s3,s4,s5: rung base topologies (configs/scale_d3_s{0,3,4,5}.json); rungs applied at eval/rollout via staged_config

compute.where: Stage A + gates: local CPU. Stage B v1/v2 DAgger: local (predate the CLAUDE.md cloud-only rule; v2 ~1h on 63 staged topos). Stage C onward: Runpod CPU pod per the HARD RULE.
